summary: FFV1 is a lossless, intra-frame video encoding format, and this informational document defines versions 0, 1 and 3 of it. It is designed to compress video in many pixel formats efficiently. Compared to uncompressed video it saves storage and adds frame fixity and self-description, which makes it useful for preservation or as an intermediate format.

eli5.summary: Imagine packing a movie into a smaller box without losing even one tiny detail. FFV1 is a recipe for doing exactly that, so libraries can store old films safely and take up less room.
